focus_areas: Fur texture realism and edge definition against the background
Anatomical correctness of the forelimbs and paw details
Species-specific facial proportions (blunt head, small eyes)
Structural integrity of the second wombat on the left edge
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the transition between the wombat's fur and the background elements. AI often struggles with the fine, wiry texture of wombat fur, causing it to look like a solid mass or blur into the surroundings. Also, scrutinize the paws; ensure they look like distinct biological structures capable of digging, rather than melted stumps. Verify that the second wombat on the left does not exhibit edge-melting artifacts.
image_description: The image displays two wombats in an enclosure with a dirt and straw floor. The primary subject is a large, stocky wombat in the center-right, facing right towards a wooden wall. It has coarse, greyish-brown fur and a robust, barrel-shaped body. A second wombat is partially visible on the far left, showing its rear and side. The background consists of a corrugated metal fence and a wooden structure.
